notes.title: "Adventure" Puzzler Bundle is HERE!
notes.notes: [p]Both being Sokoban-like games, these two titles share many parallel design elements — some concepts coincidentally align, while others reveal intriguing differences. And coincidentally, both games have 'Adventure' in their titles, so we thought it'd be nice to bundle them together.[/p][p][/p][p]P.S. I also followed development of Kiko for a long time, it has a well polished level design. And its difficulty curve is friendlier then my game :)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54475/Adventure_Puzzler/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
